name: jvto-unified-cms-control-plane
description: Codex-ready implementation workspace for the JVTO Unified CMS control plane.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:config && npm run validate:schemas && npm run validate:secrets && npm run typecheck
scripts.cms:build: npm run build && node scripts/consolidate.mjs && node scripts/render-cms.mjs && node scripts/build-design-system-extract.mjs && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/build-seed.mjs
scripts.verify:projection: node scripts/consolidate.mjs && node scripts/render-cms.mjs && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/build-seed.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- output/
